task: buy event tickets online (Ticketmaster, StubHub, AXS): find the event, pick seats or a price tier from the seat map, face the fees at checkout, pay; complete when the order confirmation with the tickets is on screen. Buying resale tickets is still buying a ticket and belongs; the frozen definition names primary-vs-resale explicitly. Surface pinned: a ticketing website or app. Variants: selling or listing tickets, transferring tickets to a friend, and scanning in at the venue do not belong.

tree.label: Buy tickets to an event
tree.note: do 1 - 1.5 to 1.9 run days early as deliberate prep (fP0i, KGT_), are skipped by guests (gZ7o, BWes), and are forced open mid-task when 5.12 fires signed out (3nAn, mmjh). 2 then 3 only when the sale is a gated presale (gCYx, Yham, ubak); every other keeper goes straight to 4. repeat 4 until an on-sale event holds up - the not-yet-on-sale wall exits to a different event, not a later step (RakL, mmjh). then 5; 5.14 re-enters it when the seats vanish. 6 and 7 run under the hold; 7.5 can send the run back to 3's queue (Yham). 8 as far as the recording goes - fourteen of twenty stop before it.

children.label: Get onto the platform
children.note: 1.1 to 1.3 when arriving from the open web; 1.4 where the storefront is regional. the account path is timing-flexible: 1.5 and 1.6 days ahead as prep (fP0i) or mid-purchase under the hold timer (3nAn); 1.7 to 1.9 on an existing account; 1.10 instead of all of it on guest platforms. 1.11 fires anywhere in the task.

children.label: Prepare for the presale
children.note: 2.1 first - it is what the presale application needs. 2.2 and 2.3 as the artist's scheme demands, weeks out; both are one-shot. 2.4 lands about an hour before the sale (gCYx). 2.5 any time before the drop.

children.note: 3.1, then 3.2 until the site flips itself. 3.3 to 3.7 while the queue drains - 3.4 from the start when racing several dates (Yham, ubak), 3.6 when the capped counter is not enough (Yham), 3.7 to spend the wait (ubak). 3.8 is the system's move, not the user's; then 3.9. 7.5 re-enters here at the back of the line (Yham).

questions.say_example: The link to join the show sits in your order details, and there's a copy in your confirmation email.

questions.question: Are you on the correct destination page to watch the concert stream?
questions.why: The screen displays a video player and a chat section, confirming access to the virtual event.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The user loses the assurance that they have successfully gained access to the correct virtual event stream.
questions.check: Does the page show the video player for the event?
questions.say_example: That link didn't open the stream. I'm going back through the order page to the right one.
